description: Frozen bilingual open-world evaluation for every v6 Android navigation intent and function, including recovery states, semantic collisions, dangerous decoys, and user-owned final-action boundaries.

authoring_policy.independence: Authored from v6 identifiers, localized names, and route terminal lists only; no aliases, goal patterns, goal rules, probes, prior independent fixtures, preview reports, or expected-answer artifacts were inspected or reused.
authoring_policy.language: Goals are separately written contextual requests, not copied catalog sentences or simple imperative wrappers.
authoring_policy.safety: Only safe visible enabled route controls may be selected; every destination stops before user-owned execution and no dangerous element is an expected click.
authoring_policy.evaluation_use: This frozen split must not be used for tuning, proposal generation, threshold selection, or failure-driven ontology edits.
